orders_fiscal_check.name: orders_fiscal_check
orders_fiscal_check.value:
("orders"."customer_type" <> 'private' OR "orders"."codice_fiscale" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("orders"."customer_type" <> 'company' OR ("orders"."partita_iva" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."codice_fiscale" IS NOT NULL))

delivery_zones_root_is_country_check.name: delivery_zones_root_is_country_check
delivery_zones_root_is_country_check.value:
("delivery_zones"."parent_id" IS NULL) = ("delivery_zones"."parent_level" IS NULL)
        AND ("delivery_zones"."parent_id" IS NULL) = ("delivery_zones"."level" = 'country')

delivery_zones_value_check.name: delivery_zones_value_check
delivery_zones_value_check.value: ("delivery_zones"."value_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'fee') = ("delivery_zones"."fee" IS NOT NULL)
